## Why it happens

An unexpected failure inside SENTIENT, most often the database being unreachable, full or overloaded. For security the details are not sent to the browser.

## Fix it

1. Try again. A short database hiccup clears by itself.
2. If it repeats, look at the server log at the same time for the real error, for example [ST-DB-001](/docs/troubleshooting/errors/st-db-001/).
3. Send the log to support. See [Collect logs for support](/docs/troubleshooting/logs/).

## Check that it worked

The action works.
